title: Verdict Transition
statement: Let $x$ be a binary input, let $b$ be a bit, let $i$ be a natural number with $i\le |x|$, let $u$ be a binary word, and let $h$ be an integer. One step from the verifier configuration in verdict state $b$, with $i$ input bits consumed, work tape containing $u$, work head at $h$, and empty output, halts and produces the one-bit output $b$, leaving the other configuration components unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: initial verdict state carries $b$ and output is empty
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input, $i \le |x|$, $u$ a word, $h$ an integer, and $b$ a bit. From the
non-tautology verifier's configuration in the verdict state with bit $b$, $i$ input
bits consumed, work word $u$, work head $h$, and empty output, one step halts with
output exactly the single bit $b$, all other components unchanged.
